name: #NO COMMENT
source:
[you] started on your project late and only have a little time to complete it. So why, after a night of drafting the lead character, does he appear in your class the very next day?

"What ? Why ? How?"

these questions only keep repeating...

[he] isn't keen on answering any of them.

[From [url=https://dimikira.itch.io/no-comment]itch.io[/url]]
